Since the issue includes clear reproduction steps, logs, and a reproducible sample, routing this to the `team-framework` for further investigation.

Thank you for the quick reply.

Unfortunatley, the workaround does not seem to be working all the time. After (quickly) dragging items multiple times the error eventually occurs.

The alternative sounds interesting, but I have no idea how that could be achieved.
Unfortunately, even with the alternative workaround the error still persists.

I was also able to get it to throw just now. Sorry about the trouble... I'll see if I can find another potential work around. I realize fixing the issue at the OverlayPortal level is the best solution, but it's nontrivial, so it'd be best to find a way around it in the meantime. Alternatively, Tooltip could be reverted, but that doesn't fix the underlying problem.

issue.body:
Fixes https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/180569
Fixes https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/177693

- Moves `_RenderDeferredLayoutBox` from `Element.activate`/`Element.deactivate` to `RenderObject.attach`/`RenderObject.detach`.
- Makes `_addDeferredChild`/`_removeDeferredChild` reentrant.

Before this `OverlayPortalElement.deactivate` removes the overlay child render object from `Overlay`. This is fine but in `OverlayPortalElement.activate` the `OverlayPortal`'s render object has not reattach yet so the RO mutation check fails because it couldn't find the ancestor actively doing layout for the overlay child render object, when it tries to re-attach.
